# Aarti maharajs

`aarti-maharajs.webp` is a web-optimized transparent illustration generated using the built-in image tool. The existing `aarti-clean.webp` was used only as a style/lighting reference. The pair is positioned as one separate layer on the shrine stairs, preserving the backdrop, existing worshippers and main characters.

## Prompt

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent foreground character pair for an existing warm hand-painted Gujarati Navratri story website. Reference image is style and lighting reference ONLY, do not reproduce its scenery. Create exactly TWO full-body Gujarati Hindu maharaj priests standing on invisible temple stairs, both barefoot, facing inward toward a shrine between and behind them. Left priest seen in rear three-quarter view facing right/inward, right priest seen in rear three-quarter view facing left/inward. Respectful adult men, one slightly older, traditional cream dhotis, saffron shoulder cloth, sacred thread, one holding a small brass aarti lamp, the other holding a small brass bell. Warm golden diya lighting, finely drawn storybook anime watercolor rendering consistent with the reference. Landscape composition, both priests the same scale and standing on the same baseline: left priest occupies outer left quarter and right priest outer right quarter, with a broad empty transparent middle gap for the existing goddess. Entire heads and bare feet visible with small transparent padding. Only two priests and their handheld ritual items; NO stairs, NO floor, NO shrine, NO goddess, NO scenery, NO text, NO shadows outside figures. Actual transparent alpha background.
